headline: Frequent URL Handling Reworks in Helpers
diagnosis: The recurring theme in the commit messages indicates ongoing issues with URL handling, particularly in the AbsURL and RelURL functions. Frequent fixes and reworks suggest that the current implementation is not robust enough to handle various edge cases, leading to repeated modifications.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the AbsURL and RelURL functions to identify all edge cases currently not handled.
Implement comprehensive unit tests for URL handling functions to cover various scenarios, including subdirectories and language prefixes.
Refactor the URL handling logic to simplify and enhance clarity, reducing the likelihood of future errors.
Establish a code review process focused on URL-related changes to ensure any modifications are scrutinized for potential impacts.
owner_hint: The PathSpec struct owner should take lead on this issue.
